title: Road and rail vehicle type catalog

nameKey.description: Localization key; display strings never live in content files (ADR 0011).

mode.description: road = truck; rail = locomotive; rail_wagon = shared wagon entry.

cargoCapacity.description: Road vehicle cargo capacity in units. Required for mode road.

maxWagons.description: Maximum wagons a locomotive may haul. Required for mode rail.

capacityPerWagon.description: Cargo capacity contributed by each wagon. Required for mode rail.

speedThousandths.description: Travel speed in thousandths of a tile per tick (250 = 0.25). Required for road and rail; omitted for rail_wagon.

purchase.description: Full purchase price (or per-wagon attach price for rail_wagon).

upkeepPerMonth.description: Fixed monthly upkeep per owned instance (per attached wagon for rail_wagon).

availableYear.description: Calendar year when the type appears (enforced in Issue #63).

unlockCost.description: One-time unlock cost after the type appears (enforced in Issue #63). Zero means no unlock fee.

starting.description: When true, MapPlay Buy may offer this type before unlock UI (Issue #63).
